pages.text: Even a creature as mighty as the Wither Storm can be manipulated. By crafting a gross abomination against nature, you can aggravate it into lashing out. When used at a distance, the Wither Storm will accelerate and chase its target. When used near the Wither Storm, it will draw out a Withered Symbiont if one has already been created!

This could be useful if you want to lure it to a more open area, if you expect that you can outrun it to cause a distraction, or if you $(thing)already have an item with the power of a Command Block$() and it won't summon a Withered Symbiont on its own.
